items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got the chance to do things with Straight Life and First Light with the stable of musicians that Creed had there it was: Freddie Hubbard, Grover Washington, Jr., George Benson…

ctx.x: Yeah, with McLaughlin on occasion. And I think he did some stuff with George Benson…
George Benson, Joe Beck on Miles in The Sky he was already starting to…
